nodes.name: When Called by WF10
nodes.notes:
NIVEL owner. Input from WF10 after WF12 resolved an owner:
{
  conversation_id: UUID,
  lead_phone, lead_name,
  property_id: listing_id | EB code,
  property_title, property_price,
  owner_agent_id, owner_name, owner_number
}
Creates a 2-min auction scoped to the owner and DMs the owner a claim
code. Owner replies TOMO-XXXX -> WF1 -> WF3b atomic claim (same table).
If unclaimed in 2 min, WF3c escalates owner -> guard auction.

parameters.query:
-- Create a 2-minute auction scoped to the owner agent, and mark the
-- conversation as being in the 'owner' tier.
WITH new_auction AS (
  INSERT INTO auctions (conversation_id, property_id, short_code, expires_at, notified_agents)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, generate_tomo_code(), NOW() + INTERVAL '2 minutes', ARRAY[$3]::text[])
  RETURNING auction_id, short_code, expires_at
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE conversations
  SET owner_agent_id = $3, routing_tier = 'owner', tier_notified_at = NOW()
  WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING conversation_id
)
SELECT a.auction_id, a.short_code, a.expires_at FROM new_auction a;

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, recipient_phone, body, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'outbound', 'system', $2, $3, $4::jsonb);
